environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB with AWS WAF WebACL. PgBouncer 1.21 in session pooling mode with prepared statement support (protocol-level named statements). The WAF WebACL includes a custom rate-based rule (threshold: 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP on URI path /api/session/validate) combined with a custom rule group containing a regex pattern rule that inspects response bodies for the string 'invalid padding' and when matched, activates a CAPTCHA action on subsequent requests from that IP for 300 seconds. CloudFront distribution with origin failover disabled. The ALB access logs feed into a Kinesis stream processed by a Lambda that updates a DynamoDB-backed IP reputation table, but this is async and not in the blocking path.

waf_rules.name: PaddingOracleResponseInspection
waf_rules.description: Regex match on response body for padding error indicators, triggers CAPTCHA challenge on source IP

config.pgbouncer_prepared_statements: enabled (session mode supports named prepared statements)
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
